newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Bear Stearns hires former BNDES director in Brazil.
newsitem.headline: Bear Stearns hires former BNDES director in Brazil.

text.p: Bear Stearns & Co Inc said it hired former director of Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES) Elena Landau as a managing director in international investment banking.
Based in Sao Paulo city, she will be working with the company's existing team headed by Nicholas Reade on business origination in Brazil, Bear Stearns said in a statement.

Landau was BNDES's Privatization Chief between November 1994 and June this year. Prior to joining the BNDES, Landau was an economics professor at Pontificia Universidade Catolica (PUC) in Rio de Janeiro and a consultant to various government offices.
